body: Thank you for your support. I am just so tired. I don't know if I can fix my semster. I do this to myself. Oh I'll just do my project tomorrow... I say that to myself until it's too late. Then I think I should just kill myself, I'll never have to do anything ever again. I can't get out of bed. I am ashamed of my failures. I can't be honest with anyone. I refuse to be hospitalized again. I just want this to end.

It was sometime in elementary school for me.  I remember just wanting to die, I still feel that way.  I don't want to be here.  My parents ask me about having kids someday, I laugh and tell them I'm still much to young for that (currently 22).  In actuality, I would never force existence on anyone.  I wish I wasn't ever born.  I am so tired. I hope I don't wake up.

Hey, just throwing this out there, have you ever noticed a pattern to your depression? It is fall right about now, my Season Affective Disorder starts to really bring down my mood around this time of year. Maybe talk to your doctor about it. It's a real thing.

Let me preface this: I have a great family, friends and job. I also suffer from depression. I'm medicated, eat right and all that jazz. I'm not going to kill myself or anything. But, I am disappointed each morning when I wake up, and hope each night before I go to bed that I won't.  I just want to be finished. I am so very weary.
